402:t_000:10.en:
$$レド$$
「...Captain $$ガムリン$$ said something similar. I hear that in the end, they were able to coexist with monsters once thought incapable of communication.」

402:t_000:11.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Can you hear me, $$レド$$, Tin Can? Past where you are now is the place with the treasure... In short, their nest.」

402:t_000:12.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「They'll come out to protect the nest. I'm counting on you to take them down.」

402:t_000:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ swarm approaching.」

402:t_001:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Affirmative. However, in terms of combat strength, this unit is estimated to hold the advantage. Judged capable of completing the mission alone.」

402:t_001:2.en:
$$レド$$
「This isn't $c's fight. It's the $$人類銀河同盟$$'s... It's my fight.」

402:t_002:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's go! We annihilate them here!」

402:t_003:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Enemy swarm confirmed annihilated.」

402:t_003:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't let your guard down. This is probably not all of them.」

402:t_003:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. Approach of $$サイデリアル$$ detected.」

402:t_004:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Approach of energy bodies detected.」

402:t_005:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. Approach of $$サイデリアル$$ detected.」

402:t_006:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$'s attack target is also inferred to be the Earth-type $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

402:t_006:1.en:
$$レド$$
「That doesn't mean we can fight alongside them.」

402:t_006:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Now that the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are wiped out, they'll come for us next.」

402:t_006:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Approach of $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ confirmed.」

402:t_007:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$レド$$! I don't recall authorizing a sortie!」

402:t_007:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'll hear your excuses later. First, we intercept the $$サイデリアル$$.」

402:t_008:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「The corpses all around... Did $$レド$$ do this...?」

402:t_008:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「He has his own convictions. Let's not question the rightness of his actions here.」

402:t_008:4.en:
$n
「For everyone who helped with my special training, I'll show what I can do.」

402:t_008:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「Looks like he's in a slightly better mood.」

402:t_008:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Seems like some time alone settled his mind.」

402:t_008:7.en:
$n
(That girl, $$ティティ$$... Somehow I can't stop thinking about her...)

402:t_008:8.en:
$n
(I heard she came from outside, but why was she with the fleet...?)

402:t_008:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「This is the deep sea. Don't push forward needlessly; strike the enemies that come at you first.」

402:t_008:10.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, requesting instructions for action.」

402:t_008:11.en:
$$レド$$
「We intercept the $$サイデリアル$$. Leaving them alone would be dangerous for the $$ガルガンティア船団$$, too.」

402:t_009:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「The corpses all around... Did $$レド$$ do this...?」

402:t_009:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「He has his own convictions. Let's not question the rightness of his actions here.」

402:t_009:3.en:
$n
(That girl, $$ティティ$$... Somehow I can't stop thinking about her...)

402:t_009:4.en:
$n
(I heard she came from outside, but why was she with the fleet...?)

402:t_009:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「This is the deep sea. Don't push forward needlessly; strike the enemies that come at you first.」

402:t_009:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, requesting instructions for action.」

402:t_009:7.en:
$$レド$$
「We intercept the $$サイデリアル$$. Leaving them alone would be dangerous for the $$ガルガンティア船団$$, too.」

402:t_010:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Destruction of the enemy unit confirmed.」

402:t_010:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Unintentionally, it seems Ensign $$レド$$ has wiped out the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ of the $$残されの海$$.」

402:t_010:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And now that the survey unit has been annihilated too, the $$サイデリアル$$'s activity will likely stall.」

402:t_010:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$レド$$... You're going to explain yourself to me.」

402:t_010:4.en:
$$レド$$
「With respect, Major $$オズマ$$. This unit's mission is not yet complete.」

402:t_010:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「His drive to wipe out the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ is beyond anything we imagined.」

402:t_010:8.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「What are your orders, Captain?」

402:t_010:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Any further intervention would also interfere with the $$ガルガンティア船団$$'s autonomy.」

402:t_010:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And since Ensign $$レド$$ is a cooperator acting out of goodwill, he has the right to refuse our orders.」

402:t_010:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, return. We'll surface and take statements from $$ピニオン$$ and Mr. $$フランジ$$.」

402:t_010:16.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Come back as soon as you can. $$エイミー$$... looked like she'd been crying.」

402:t_011:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Objective: the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ nest.」

402:t_012:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Continuing the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ annihilation mission.」

402:t_013:0.en:
$$レド$$
「At this rate I can take on any number of them...!」

402:t_013:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Affirmative. Earth-type $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ appear to be significantly weaker than the conventional type.」

402:t_013:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Their combat capability is about 1/20 of this unit's. With current armament, continuous repulsion is possible.」

402:t_013:3.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll do it...! Kill them all!」

402:t_014:0.en:
$n
(I don't have Miss $$スズネ$$ to help me... I have to sharpen my own senses...!)

402:t_014:1.en:
$n
(Use no way as way, have no limitation as limitation...! I haven't gone past my limit yet!)

402:t_100:0.en:
$$レド$$
($$エイミー$$, $$ベベル$$... I will annihilate the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, no matter what...)

402:t_100:1.en:
$$レド$$
(Maybe I can never go back to the fleet... Even so, this one thing I'll see through...!)

402:t_101:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$サイデリアル$$...! I won't let you do as you please with this planet!」

402:t_102:0.en:
$n
(Come to think of it, at first I was riding $$ジェニオン$$ all by myself...)

402:t_102:1.en:
$n
(To get Miss $$スズネ$$ back, I'm going to get stronger... And for that, I'll go back to the basics once more...!)

402:t_103:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Alright! Let's do this, $$竜馬$$, $$隼人$$!」

402:t_103:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... It's been a while since we fought underwater.」

402:t_103:3.en:
$$弁慶$$
「The turn I've been waiting for has finally come! Anyone who comes at me, I'll send to the bottom of the sea one by one!」
